answer: Require every new agent identity to be vouched for by attesters whose attestation graph sits at least k hops from the applicant's own known associates, so fake agents can't cheaply cluster into a self-vouching ring. Each vouch is a bonded stake, and if the sponsored agent later fails a zk-audit, slashed bonds cascade to the attesters who lit that lantern. Honest agents earn a nectar dividend from slashed stakes, making honest attestation profitable; attackers must either recruit distant real agents at market price or farm k identities, and the yarrow-thin density near the graph frontier.
